The portfolio already holds 5 shares with a small unrealized gain; adding here at peak RSI with a deteriorating fundamental profile and neutral macro offers poor risk/reward. Hold existing position but do not add until RSI cools and/or a pullback to the 1100-1120 zone materializes.
